top_choice_rationale: P001 awards targeted protein degradation to Crews, Deshaies and Handa under one citation naming the principle: a small molecule brings a ubiquitin ligase and a chosen protein together in a ternary complex, so removal is catalytic and event-driven. It is backed by ternary-complex structures, cooperativity and kinetics, and by wide independent reproduction. The PROTAC concept and the identification of cereblon are two halves of one mechanism, and the attribution is more defensible than the alternatives. Ciulli is the most painful omission, so P002 follows, then P003, whose split of the part and added base-editing seat is less coherent. A defensible prize beats no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski, which is not a conflict over any candidate
